description.narrative: The HPMP was approved by the 62th Meeting of the Executive Committee (ExCom) of the Multilateral Fund for the Implementation of the Montreal Protocol and the agreement between the Country and the Executive Committee was amended by its 71st Meeting. The main objective of the HPMP was to enable the Government of Turkmenistan to phase-out its HCFC consumption in the servicing sector which was the biggest consumer of HCFCs and growing. The Government of Turkmenistan adopted the HPMP and obliged the State Committee on Environment protection and Land Resources of Turkmenistan to implement planned activities in a timely manner. The Government committed to reduce the consumption of HCFCs by 35% from the calculated baseline by the year 2020. The HCFC Stage I was implemented through a combination of investment and non-investment activities in the refrigeration and air-conditioning service sectors of the Turkmenistan (2010-2020). Furthermore, activities contained in the HPMP were focused on enforcement measures, strengthening of legislation, support to the refrigeration servicing sector, training of service technicians, creation of the ozone-depleting substances (ODS) quality control laboratory, training of customs officers and awareness raising. The main result achieved was the phase out of 10% by 2015 and 35% by 2020.
